blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision--language models (VLMs) promise to make computational pathology queryable and able to draft reports, but how much language adds beyond the vision backbone is unclear, because almost every system is evaluated by its developers on test sets of their own choosing. We grade published evidence by how it was produced and test four claims with controlled probes that reuse released checkpoints and public data, varying one input at a time. Report text adds prognostic signal: adding a frozen embedding of the stage-redacted report to a slide embedding raises the pooled C-index by 0.019 for progression-free interval and by 0.016 for overall survival across 1{,}633 TCGA patients, and restoring the stage statement adds nothing. Prompts add no measurable accuracy at inference: with features and pooling fixed, zero-shot classification is statistically indistinguishable from a supervised linear probe for lung and renal cancer subtyping. Slide-level question answering is barely grounded: SlideChat answers 74.82\% of SlideBench-VQA(TCGA) items correctly with the slide and 74.41\% without it, whereas its language backbone alone reaches 43.52\%. Paraphrasing leaves accuracy unchanged but flips 8--23\% of answers. Self-reported gains from agentic navigation and few-shot language priors cannot yet be attributed to language. Language thus adds real but narrow value, and we propose minimum controls that would expose these failure modes in future evaluations.
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs)承诺使计算病理可查询并能够起草报告,但是除了视觉主干之外,有多少语言添加的内容还不清楚,因为几乎每个系统都由开发者在自己选择的测试集上评价. 我们对公布的证据进行分级,按其制作方式分列,并用可控制的探测器检验4项索赔,这些探测器重新利用了检查站和公共数据,每次输入一次。 报告文本增加了预想信号:在幻灯片嵌入中添加被冻结的相接报告嵌入,使集合的C-指数上升0.019,无相接间隔上升0.016,1{,}633个TCGA患者总体存活上升0.016,恢复相接状态语句没有任何增加. 提示在推论上没有增加可测量的准确性:如果特征和集合固定,零发分级在统计上与受监督的肺癌和肾癌分型线性探针是无法区分的。 幻灯片关卡问题答案几乎没有被禁入: 幻灯片 恰克回答74.82 QQA(TCGA)项目的滑行本克-VQA(TCGA)项目与滑行本正确,74.41QQ没有滑行本克,而单是其语言主干就达到 43.52Q. 校对:Soup 自报从代理导航得到的收益和少有shot语言前传还不能归结于语言. 因此,语言增加了实际但狭隘的价值,我们提出最低限度的控制措施,在今后的评估中揭露这些失败模式。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision–language models (VLMs) couple a histology encoder to a text encoder or a large language model, so that one system can classify tissue from a prompt, retrieve similar cases, answer free-text questions and draft reports [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] . Pure-vision models already reach clinical-grade accuracy on narrow tasks [ 6 ] , so the question for adoption is whether language makes pathology AI better or merely more persuasive: free text can assert findings that are not in the tissue, a fluent rationale can pass for evidence, and an answer that changes with the wording of a question is incompatible with diagnosis.
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs)将一个神学编码器与一个文本编码器或一个大语言模型相配,这样一个系统就可以从一个即时,检索出类似的病例,回答自由文本问题并起草报告[1,2,3,4,5]. 纯视模型在狭义的任务上已经达到临床等级的准确性[6],所以要通过的问题在于语言是使病理AI更好,还是仅仅是更具有说服力:自由文本可以断言组织内没有的发现,流利的理由可以传递给证据,一个与一个问题的措辞变化的答案与诊断不一致.

blocks.en: Published results cannot settle this. Almost every system is evaluated by the group that built it, on test data of its own choosing and under its own protocol; the most-used benchmarks are exposed to contamination (Section 2 ); and the decisive comparisons are rarely run: whether language improves subtyping and survival, where vision is already strong, whether slide-level answers depend on the slide, and whether they survive rewording.
blocks.zh: 公布的结果不能解决这个问题。 几乎每个系统都由建立它的团体根据自己选择的测试数据并根据自己的协议进行评估;最常用的基准暴露于被污染(第2节);决定性的比较很少运行:语言是否改进了子打字和生存,视线已经很强,滑行级的答案是否取决于滑行,它们是否存活了重写.

blocks.en: Here we weigh these claims directly. We grade evidence by how it was produced and run four controlled probes under one leakage-controlled harness, reusing released checkpoints and public data and varying a single input at a time. The probes isolate the language increment on survival prediction (Probe 1) and subtyping (Probe 2), test whether slide-level visual question answering (VQA) is grounded in the slide (Probe 3), and measure robustness to semantically equivalent rewording (Probe 4). We then grade the self-reported evidence for agentic navigation and few-shot language priors and distil the results into minimum controls. This article expands the evidence-weighing analysis of our companion review of 51 pathology VLMs [ 7 ] , from which literature-derived statements are drawn; following that review, we distinguish contrastive encoders, instruction-tuned assistants, reasoning-tuned models, agents and VLM-augmented multiple-instance learning (MIL).
blocks.zh: 我们在这里直接权衡这些主张。 我们通过它是如何产生和运行4个控制探测器 在一个控制渗漏的管子下 重新使用已释放的检查站和公共数据 探测器在生存预测(Probe 1)和子打字(Probe 2)上隔离出语言增量,测试滑动水平的视觉问题回答(VQA)是否被基于滑动(Probe 3),并测量稳健度来模拟等效重写(Probe 4). 然后我们把自我报告的证据分级 用于代理导航 和几发语言的前科 并把结果分解到最低控制中 这篇文章扩展了我们对51个病理VLMs [7] 的同源评论的旁观分析,从中得出出文献衍生的语句;在评论后,我们区分了对比编码器,指令调校助手,推理调校模型,代理和VLM调校多功能学习(MIL).

blocks.en: 2 Evidence standards and benchmarks
blocks.zh: 2个 证据标准和基准

blocks.en: We weigh each published result by how it was produced, in three tiers: an independent re-evaluation of several systems under one protocol (tier 1), a third-party reproduction of a single system (tier 2), and a number a system reports about itself (tier 3). Our probes are tier-1 evidence, as are PathVLM-Eval [ 8 ] and the feature-extractor benchmark of Neidlinger et al. [9] .
blocks.zh: 我们用它是如何产生的来权衡每个公布的结果,分为三个层次:对一个协议(第一级)下的几个系统进行独立的重新评价,对一个单一系统(第二级)进行第三方复制,以及一个系统报告自己的数字(第三级)。 我们的探测器是一级证据,PathVLM-Eval [8] 和Neidlinger等人的地物提取基准也是如此。 [9] (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en: Table 1 lists the public benchmarks in current use. Most comparisons rest on three patch-level sets, PathMMU, PathVQA and Quilt-VQA, and all three are exposed to contamination: their images come from the literature, textbooks, educational videos and social media, the kinds of source that also populate pathology pretraining corpora [ 1 , 10 ] , and their question–answer pairs were generated semi-automatically or with language-model assistance. Slide-level benchmarks built from TCGA typically share their source cohort with the instruction-tuning data of the assistants evaluated on them [ 11 , 12 ] . We therefore anchor the analysis on leakage-controlled evaluations.
blocks.zh: 表1列出了目前使用的公共基准。 大多数比较都基于PathMMU,PathVQA和Quilt-VQA三个补丁级的组合,这三个组合都受到污染:他们的图像来自文献,教科书,教育视频和社交媒体,同样流行病理学预训阵型[1,10]的源头,以及他们的问答对子都是半自动生成的,或者有语言模型协助的. 由TCGA制定的幻灯片级基准通常与对其进行评估的助理的指导调整数据共享源组[11、12]。 因此,我们把分析建立在控制渗漏的评估上。

blocks.en: Table 1: Public evaluation benchmarks used by current pathology VLMs, with counts as reported by their sources. Items count images, whole-slide images (WSIs), patients or pairs; Questions count question–answer pairs. Gran., granularity (G1, patch; G2, region of interest; G3, whole slide); MCQ, multiple-choice question; VQA, visual question answering; ST, spatial transcriptomics; NR, not reported; —, not applicable. WSI-Bench counts include its training split.
blocks.zh: 表1:目前病理学的VLM使用的公共评价基准,其来源报告的计数. 项目计数图像,全滑图像(WSI),病人或对;问题计数问答对. Gran.,颗粒性(G1,补丁;G2,兴趣区;G3,全滑;MCQ,多选题;VQA,视觉问答;ST,空间转录;NR,未上报;-,不适用. WSI-Bench计数包括其训练分出.

blocks.en: 3 Controlled probes
blocks.zh: 3个 受控探测器

blocks.en: All probes freeze the representation, hold the predictor and the evaluation split fixed, and vary a single input. Models are public releases used without modification, and assistants run under their authors’ inference code. The encoder probes use patient- and tissue-source-site-disjoint five-fold splits, which keep site signatures from crossing folds [ 22 ] ; the VQA probes are pure inference over released items. We report 95% confidence intervals (CIs) from 1,000 bootstrap resamples at a fixed seed, resampling cases in Probes 1–2 and questions in Probes 3–4, and call an effect significant when its CI excludes zero.
blocks.zh: 所有探测器都冻结了表示,将预测器和评价分出固定,并改变单一输入. 模型是未经修改而使用的公开发布,助手根据作者推断代码运行. 编码器探测器采用病人与组织-来源-站点相分离的5倍分法,使站点签名无法通过折叠[22];VQA探测器是对被放出物品的纯推论. 我们报告在固定种子中从1 000个靴子重新标出95%的置信间隔(CI),在1至2号探测器中重新标出病例,在3至4号探测器中重新标出问题,当CI排除了零时则称效果是显著的。

blocks.en: Slides from TCGA-BRCA, -LUAD and -COAD [ 23 ] are paired with progression-free interval (PFI) and overall survival (OS) from the TCGA Clinical Data Resource [ 24 ] (pooled n = 1,633 n=1{,}633 ; 394 PFI and 345 OS events). Report text is the report-derived text of the public SlideInstruct/SlideBench-Caption release [ 11 ] , filtered to remove follow-up and outcome sentences. A frozen PubMedBERT report embedding [ 25 ] is concatenated with the frozen TITAN slide embedding [ 4 ] , and an L2-penalised linear Cox model [ 26 ] is fitted. Six arms differ only in their input: A, vision; B, vision with the full report; B ′ B^{\prime} , vision with a stage-redacted report; C, structured stage and grade; T full T_{\mathrm{full}} and T red T_{\mathrm{red}} , report text alone. Pooled out-of-fold Harrell’s C-index [ 27 ] is compared through four contrasts: clean language increment ( B ′ − A B^{\prime}-A ), staging leakage ( B − B ′ B-B^{\prime} ), text-channel leakage ( T full − T red T_{\mathrm{full}}-T_{\mathrm{red}} ) and text versus vision ( T red − A T_{\mathrm{red}}-A ).
blocks.zh: TCGA-BRCA,-LUAD和-COAD [23] 的幻灯片与TCGA临床数据资源[24]的无累进间隔(PFI)和总体存活率(OS)相配(集合n= 1,633n=1{,}633;394个PFI和345个OS事件). 报告正文是公共幻灯片"Instruct"/"Slide Bench-Caption"的出自报告正文 [11],被过滤去去除后续和结果句. 被冻结的PubMedBERT报告嵌入 [25] 被与被冻结的 TITAN 幻灯片嵌入 [4]相配合,并装入了L2级的线性Cox模型 [26]. 6个武器仅在投入方面有所不同: A,视觉;B,视觉有完整的报告;B'B^{\prime',视觉有分阶段编辑的报告;C,结构化阶段和分级;T全T_{\mathrm{full}}和T红T_{\mathrm{red}},仅报告文本. 集合外的Harrell的C-index[27]通过四个对比比较:干净的语言增量(B ' − A B^{\prime}-A),中转渗出(B-B-B^{\prime}),文本通道渗出(T全-T红色T_{\mathrm{ful}}-T_{\mathrm{red}}})和文本与视觉(T红-A_{\mathrm{red}}-A.

blocks.en: TCGA NSCLC (LUAD versus LUSC; N = 930 N=930 ) and RCC (KIRC, KIRP and KICH; N = 718 N=718 ) slides are embedded by three language-aligned encoders, CONCH v1 [ 2 ] , CONCH v1.5 and the TITAN slide encoder built on it [ 4 ] , and by the pure-vision Prov-GigaPath [ 28 ] . Each yields one vector per slide, on which an L2-penalised multinomial logistic head is fitted and scored by balanced accuracy. Within CONCH v1, zero-shot classification with top- k k or mean pooling over tiles is compared with supervised linear probes on the same features.
blocks.zh: TCGA NSCLC(LUAD对LUSC;N = 930 N = 930)和RCC(KIRC,KIRP和KICH;N = 718 N = 718)幻灯片由三个语言相通编码器嵌入而成,CONCH v1 [2],CONCH v1.5和所建TITAN幻灯片编码器由纯视Prov-Gigapath [28]. 每张滑行会产生一个矢量,上面装上一个L2级多号后勤头并按平衡的准确度打分。 在CONCH v1中,用上-k k或平面相聚于瓦片的零射入分级比作同一特征上受监督的线性探测器.

blocks.en:
SlideChat [ 11 ] and WSI-LLaVA [ 12 ] , with two text-only models, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct [ 29 ] (the language backbone of SlideChat) and Qwen3-8B [ 30 ] , answer the 1,227 SlideBench-VQA(TCGA) multiple-choice items whose slides could be re-encoded locally (CLAM tiling [ 31 ] , CONCH features).
Relative to the unperturbed condition (P0), we remove the slide, zero its features, substitute a mismatched slide, cyclically shift the options, or replace the correct option with “none of the above” (NOTA). A single deterministic parser reads the answers; the most-frequent-letter baseline is 40.7%.
blocks.zh:
SlietChat [11]和WSI-LLAVA [12],有两个只使用文字的模型,Qun2.5-7B-指示 [29] (SlietChat的语言主干)和Qun3-8B [30],回答1,227 Slit Bench-VQA(TCGA)多选择项目,其幻灯片可以重新本地编码(CLAM tilling [31],CONCH特征).
相对于未扰动条件(P0),我们删除了幻灯片,零其特性,取而代之的是不匹配的幻灯片,周期性地转移选项,或者用“上述任何一种”来取而代之。 单一的确定解析器读取答案;最常用的字母基线为40.7%.

blocks.en: SlideChat, Qwen3-VL [ 32 ] , InternVL3 [ 33 ] and a text-only Qwen3 answer a matched multiple-choice subset of SlideBench-VQA (TCGA and BCNB). With slide, question content and correct answer fixed, each item is posed canonically and in banks of semantically equivalent paraphrases, of prompt reframings (a different framing sentence or an added persona line), and of both. We report the accuracy change (canonical minus perturbed), the fraction of items whose answer flips, and answer consistency across each bank.
blocks.zh: FliedChat, Quen3-VL [32], InternVL3 [33] 和只使用文本的Quen3 回答匹配的多选择子集 Slide Bench-VQA(TCGA和BCNB). 随着幻灯片、提问内容和正确答案的固定,每个项目都按逻辑排列,并用模拟等同的语句、即时重写(不同的框架句子或增加的人名行)和两种语句。 我们报告准确性的变化(canonical nind percurbled), 回答翻转的部分, 以及每个银行的一致性。

blocks.en: Linear heads and bootstrap run on CPU; zero-shot and multimodal inference run on up to two NVIDIA H200 NVL GPUs in bf16, and no model is trained or fine-tuned. Claims that the probes do not address are graded from the 51 systems of the companion review [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 线性头和靴子被运行在CPU上;零镜头和多模式推论运行在bf16中最多2个NVIDIA H200 NVL GPU上,没有模型经过训练或微调. 关于探测器未覆盖的声称,从伴行审查的51个系统分级[7].

blocks.en: 4.1 Report text adds prognostic signal that survives stage redaction
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 报告文本添加在舞台编辑后幸存的预告信号

blocks.en: Vision–language foundation models report better survival prediction than pure-vision models [ 4 , 5 ] , but reports state tumour stage, so the gain could merely restate it. The clean increment B ′ − A B^{\prime}-A was positive and significant in all six cohort–endpoint settings and pooled to + 0.019 +0.019 C-index for PFI and + 0.016 +0.016 for OS (Fig. 1 b). Stage does not explain it: both leakage contrasts were null, the redacted report alone was at least as prognostic as the slide embedding, and structured stage and grade (arm C) formed the weakest arm (Fig. 1 a). The increment is therefore not a restatement of the stage statement. It is information in the report that complements the slide, captured by a frozen text encoder rather than by a VLM, and redaction leaves stage-correlated findings such as tumour size in place.
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言基础模型报告的生存预测比纯视觉模型[4,5]要好,但报告是肿瘤阶段,因此收益只能重复. 清洁增量B ' -- -- A B -- -- A -- -- A在所有六个组别 -- -- 端点设置中都是积极和显著的,集合到PFI的+0.019+0.019 C-指数,OS的+0.016+0.016 (图1b)。 阶段无法解释:两种渗漏对比都是无效的,仅经过编辑的报告至少与幻灯片嵌入一样具有预想性,结构化的阶段和级别(arm C)构成了最弱的手臂(图1a). 因此,递增不是阶段说明的重述。 报告中的信息是对幻灯片的补充,它是被被一个被冻结的文本编码器而不是一个VLM所捕获的,而编辑会留下诸如肿瘤大小等与舞台相关的发现.

blocks.en: 4.2 Language pays through pretrained features, not prompts
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 语言通过预先训练的功能而不是提示支付

blocks.en: Language enters a contrastive VLM twice, as pretraining supervision and as zero-shot prompts; if predictive power lives in the features, a laboratory can replace prompts with a supervised classifier and avoid prompt sensitivity. Under identical supervised probes, all three language-aligned encoders outperformed Prov-GigaPath on both tasks (Fig. 1 c). A probe uses no prompt, so the advantage resides in the features; but the encoders also differ in backbone, data, dimension and aggregation, so it cannot be attributed to language. The within-encoder arm isolates the prompt: with CONCH v1 features and pooling fixed, zero-shot classification was statistically indistinguishable from the linear probe (balanced-accuracy difference − 0.020 -0.020 for NSCLC and − 0.019 -0.019 for RCC; Fig. 1 d). Top- k k zero-shot classification scored higher, but its margin vanished under shared pooling, an instance-selection rather than a prompt effect. With CONCH ranked first of 19 foundation models as a weakly supervised feature extractor in an independent benchmark [ 9 ] , the evidence indicates that, for in-distribution subtyping, vision–language pretraining pays, if at all, through the features it shapes rather than through prompts.
blocks.zh: 语言会两次进入对比VLM,作为前训练的导出和0发的导出;如果预测能活在特征中,实验室可以用被监督的分级器来取代导出并避免被迅速的敏感. 在相同的受监督探测器下,所有三种语言相通编码器在两个任务(图1 c)上都超过了普罗夫-吉加帕特. 探测器没有使用即时,所以优势在于特性;但编码器在骨干,数据,维度和聚合上也有不同,因此不能归结于语言. 编码器内臂能隔离出快件:带有CONCH v1特性并固定集合,从统计学上讲,零发分级与线性探针是无法区分的(NSCLC的平衡-准确性差为-0.020-0.020;RCC为-0.019-0.019;图1d)。 Top -- k k 零发分级得分较高, 但是它的比值在共享集合下消失了, 一个实例选择,而不是一个迅速的效果。 由于CONCH在19个基础模型中排名第一,成为独立基准中受弱度监督的特征提取器[9],证据表明,对于分化分型,视觉-语言预训通过它塑造的特征而不是通过提示来支付费用。

blocks.en: 4.3 Slide-level VQA accuracy does not depend on the slide
blocks.zh: 4.3 幻灯片级别 VQA 精度不取决于幻灯片

blocks.en: A multiple-choice benchmark can be passed without looking, by exploiting answer distributions and option positions. SlideChat answered 74.82% of items correctly with the slide, and its text-only and mismatched-slide gaps were indistinguishable from zero, including on grading and staging questions; WSI-LLaVA lost a few points, significantly (Fig. 2 a,b). The prior is learned in training: Qwen2.5-7B, SlideChat’s own backbone, answered 43.52% correctly without the slide, close to the 40.7% letter baseline, whereas SlideChat, equally blind, answered 74.41%, so about 31 points come from regularities of its instruction-tuning data rather than from the slide. The assistants were instead sensitive to answer format: shifting option positions lowered accuracy significantly, and substituting NOTA for the correct option pushed SlideChat below the letter baseline, so neither model rejects the remaining options once the correct content is removed.
blocks.zh: 通过利用答案分布和选项位置,可以不看就通过多种选择基准。 幻灯片 查特以幻灯片正确回答74.82%的项目,其文本上和不匹配的滑行间隙与零无法区分,包括在分级和中转问题上;WSI-LLaVA损失了几分,显著(图2 a,b). 前一个是在训练中学习的:Quen2.5-7B,幻灯片 查特自己的骨干,没有滑行正确回答43.52%,接近40.7%的字母基线,而同样失明的SlideChat回答74.41%,因此大约31分来自其指示调取数据的规律性而不是从幻灯片中得出. 助理们反而对回答格式很敏感:移动选项位置会大幅降低精度,用NOTA来代替正确的选项将SlideChat推向了字母基线以下,因此在正确的内容被去掉后,两个模型都没有拒绝其余的选项.

blocks.en: 4.4 Rewording leaves accuracy intact but changes the answers
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 重写精度不变,但会改变答案

blocks.en: Under paraphrase alone, the accuracy change was indistinguishable from zero for all four systems (Fig. 2 d), so we detect no accuracy cost. The answers, however, were unstable: 8–23% of items changed answer under paraphrase and 25% under paraphrase plus reframing, where consistency fell to 0.57. Even SlideChat, the most stable system, changed a quarter of its answers when only the framing sentence varied, and a single persona line shifted Qwen3-VL’s accuracy significantly, the only accuracy changes whose intervals excluded zero. Leaderboards cannot see this instability; in the clinic, where the same case must yield the same diagnosis, it is disqualifying.
blocks.zh: 仅根据解释,所有四个系统(图2d)的准确性变化与零是无法区分的,因此我们检测不到准确性成本。 然而,答案是不稳定的:8-23%的项目在解释下作了回答,25%在解释后作了修改,一致性降至0.57。 即使是最稳定的SlideChat系统,当只有框架句子不同时,它也会改变四分之一的答案,单人行会显著地改变Qune3-VL的精度,这是间隔排除为零的唯一精度变化. 领导板看不到这种不稳定性;在诊所,同一病例必须作出同样的诊断,这是取消资格。

blocks.en: 4.5 Self-reported gains cannot yet be attributed
blocks.zh: 4.5 自我报告的收益尚不能归结

blocks.en: Two further claims rest on self-reported evidence (tier 3; Fig. 2 c). Agentic navigation produces its largest margins where they are least separable. CPathAgent reaches 88.6% on PathMMU-HR 2 , 15.4 points above Gemini-2.5-Pro answering in a single pass, yet at slide level it leads ABMIL by 2.9 points on average and trails TITAN on CPTAC-Lung (88.1% versus 91.9%) [ 16 ] . The margin thus depends on scale, and only part of it is navigation: prompted to navigate in the same way, Gemini-2.5-Pro rises from 73.2% to 76.4%. With no intervals or seeds reported, neither component can be tested. Language priors in MIL earn smaller and more consistent margins: ViLa-MIL, VLEER and GMAT report few-shot gains over language-free aggregators while training fewer than 10 7 10^{7} parameters [ 34 , 35 , 36 ] , for example 1.7 and 5.9 AUC points for ViLa-MIL over CLAM-MB with 16 shots (Fig. 2 c). Every such comparison comes from the proposing paper without independent or leakage-controlled replication, so we grade this evidence as weakly supported.
blocks.zh: 还有2件索赔依据的是自报的证据(第3级;图2c)。 代理导航在其最不相分离的地方产生最大的边距。 CPathAgent在PathMU-HR 2上达到88.6%,比双子座-2.5-Pro的答题高出15.4分,然而在滑行水平上,它平均领先ABMIL2.9分,在CPTAC-Lung上追踪TITAN(88.1%对91.9%) [16]. 因此比值取决于比例,只有部分是导航:被激励以同样的方式导航,双子座-2.5-Pro从73.2%上升到76.4%. 在没有报告间隔或种子的情况下,两个部件都无法测试。 MIL的语文前科收入更小、更一致的差值:ViLa-MIL、VLEER和GMAT报告,在无语文聚合器上只取得少许成绩,而培训的参数则少于10个7 10^{7}[34、35、36],例如ViLa-MIL的AUC分数为1.7和5.9,在CLAM-MB上为16发(图2 c)。 每个这样的比较都来自提议的文件,没有独立或受渗漏控制的复制,所以我们把这种证据评为弱支持.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: Visibility reorders clinical risk: the hallucinations of generative systems surface as text that a reader can check, whereas score-only systems (contrastive encoders and VLM-augmented MIL) fail through correlational shortcuts, such as a frozen encoder passing a tissue-source-site signature onward [ 22 ] , and leave a confident, wrong prediction with no trace. Long-tail behaviour is rarely reported: among the catalogued systems, HiPath falls from 70.2% on head terms to 2.6% on tail terms [ 37 ] , MR-PLIP reaches 0.745 balanced accuracy on 30 EBRAINS brain-tumour subtypes [ 38 ] , CPathAgent scores 64.3% on three-class BRACS regions [ 16 ] , and paediatric tumours are assessed only by KEEP, on 816 WSIs from one hospital [ 39 ] . Calibration and abstention are absent: networks are poorly calibrated by default [ 40 ] , free text carries no calibrated confidence, selective prediction [ 41 ] goes unused, and none of the 51 systems reports calibrated confidence. Compute is reported sporadically and in incompatible units: a few papers give training budgets [ 42 , 37 ] , only LAMMI-Pathology reports a memory footprint [ 43 ] , and none compares runtimes across paradigms or estimates carbon cost [ 44 ] , although instruction-tuned assistants (7B–15B parameters) need roughly 10 4 10^{4} visual tokens and 40–80 GB of GPU memory per WSI at inference.
blocks.zh: 可见度重排临床风险:基因系的幻觉会作为读取器可以检查的文本而表面,而只得分的系统(相接编码器和VLM-加分的MIL)则通过相关快捷方式失效,如被冻结的编码器通过组织-来源-站点的签名向上走去[22],并留下自信,错误的预测而无痕迹. 在编目系统中,HiPath从头部的70.2%下降到尾部的2.6%[37],MR-PLIP在30种EBRAINS脑震荡亚型上达到0.745的平衡精度[38],CPathAgent在三等BRCS区评分为64.3%[16],而小儿肿瘤只由KEEP评估,在一个医院的816个WSI中评分. [39]. 校正和弃权缺失:网络默认校正差 [40] ,自由文本没有校正的置信度,选择性预测 [41] 未被使用,51个系统都没有报告校正了置信度. 计算是零星的和不兼容的单位:少数论文给出培训预算[42,37],只有LAMMI-Pathology报告记忆足迹[43],没有一篇论文可以比较跨范式的运行时间或估计碳成本[44],尽管指示调制的助手(7B–15B参数)需要大约10个可视化符号和每WSI推论40–80GBGPU内存.

blocks.en: Each failure reported here was exposed by a cheap control. We propose that evaluations of pathology VLMs report, at a minimum: (i) for slide-conditioned VQA, text-only, mismatched-slide, option-shift and NOTA arms alongside the majority-answer baseline; (ii) answer-flip rates and consistency under paraphrase and reframing; (iii) stage-redacted and text-only arms for claims that text improves prognosis; (iv) within-encoder comparisons for claims about prompts; (v) CIs and seeds for every headline comparison, preferably with independent replication; and (vi) compute in six fields: GPU type and count, GPU-hours, peak training memory, peak inference memory, visual tokens per WSI, and end-to-end latency on a reference slide. For design, language at inference is best spent where it is irreplaceable (prognosis, interaction and reporting), and grounding should become a training objective: answers should cite tissue evidence, change when it changes, abstain when it is absent and stay invariant to paraphrase. None of this replaces clinical validation through multisite testing, subgroup reporting and prospective reader studies.
blocks.zh: 这里报道的每一次失败都是通过廉价的控制被暴露的. 我们提议,对病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理病理 GPU类型和计数,GPU-hours,峰值训练内存,峰值推断内存,每个WSI的可视符号,以及参考幻灯片上从端到端的延迟. 就设计而言,推断的语言最好在不可替代的地方使用(预测、互动和报告),地面定位应当成为一个培训目标:答案应当引用组织证据,变化时会改变,缺席时会弃权,并且不灵活解释。 这些都不是通过多站点测试、分组报告和未来的读者研究来取代临床验证的。

blocks.en: The probes cover released checkpoints on TCGA-derived data, two slide-level assistants, three language-aligned encoders and one pure-vision encoder; reasoning-tuned, agentic and MIL systems are not probed directly. In Probe 1, a null leakage contrast would also arise if the frozen text encoder were insensitive to stage statements, no arm combines vision with structured stage and grade, and the report text is a processed release. In Probe 2, the cross-encoder comparison is confounded, and zero-shot and supervised heads are compared under mean pooling only, without learned instance selection such as attention-based MIL. Probes 3 and 4 use multiple-choice items, so free-text generation may behave differently, and the navigation and few-shot grades rest on self-reported numbers.
blocks.zh: 探测器覆盖了根据TCGA数据发布的检查点,2个幻灯片级助手,3个语言相通编码器和1个纯视觉编码器;推理调试,代理和MIL系统没有被直接探测. 在"探测一"中,如果被冷冻的文本编码器对相位语句不敏感,没有手臂将视觉与结构化的相位和分级结合,报告文本是经过处理的放出,也会产生无效的漏出对比. 在"Probe 2"中,交叉编码器的比较是令人困惑的,零发和被监督的头只在"平均集合"下进行比较,没有像基于注意力的MIL这样的学习实例选择. 3号和4号探测器使用多选择物品,因此自由文本生成可能表现不同,导航和几发分数都取自自自报的数字.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Weighed by controlled probes rather than headline numbers, language adds real but narrow value to pathology VLMs. Report text carries prognostic signal that survives stage redaction, but prompts add no discriminative accuracy at inference, and slide-level answers are neither grounded in the slide nor stable under rewording. Until grounding, paraphrase consistency and calibration are reported as routinely as accuracy, benchmark scores should be read as upper bounds on what a model reads from the slide, not as evidence that it does.
blocks.zh: 由受控探测器而不是头条编号来维系,语言为病理VLM增加了真实而狭义的价值. 报告文本带有在舞台编辑后幸存的预想信号,但提示在推断时没有添加有歧义的准确性,而滑行级的答案既不被固定在幻灯片上,也不在重写下稳定. 在打地之前,译出的一致性和校正性作为准确性例行报告,基准分数应读取为模型从幻灯片读取的上限,而不是它所读取的证据。

blocks.en: Data and code availability
blocks.zh: 数据和代码的可用性

blocks.en: All data are public and de-identified, and no new human-subjects data were collected. Whole-slide images and clinical endpoints are from TCGA and the TCGA Clinical Data Resource via the NIH Genomic Data Commons ( https://portal.gdc.cancer.gov ); report-derived text and VQA items are from the public SlideChat release ( https://huggingface.co/datasets/General-Medical-AI/SlideChat ). All checkpoints (CONCH v1 and v1.5, TITAN, Prov-GigaPath, PubMedBERT, SlideChat, WSI-LLaVA, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-VL and InternVL3) are public releases. A maintained list of pathology VLMs is available at https://github.com/wenhaozhang0066/Awesome-Pathology-VLMs .
blocks.zh: 所有数据都是公开的和不识别的,没有收集新的人类主体数据。 全滑图象和临床终点取自TCGA和TCGA临床数据资源,通过NIH基因组数据共同系统(https://portal.gdc.cancer.gov);报告出处文本和VQA项目取自公共幻灯片Chat发布(https://huggingface.co/datasets/General-Medical-AI/SlideChat.). 所有检查站(CONCH v1和v1.5、TITAN、Prov-Gigapath、PubMedBERT、SlietChat、WSI-LLAVA、Qune2.5-7B-Instruct、Qune3-8B、Qune3-VL和InternVL3)均为公开发布。 在https://github.com/wenhaozhang0066/Awesome-Pathology-VLMs上,有一份保存的病理病理病理病理病理学清单。 。 。 。 。
